2609.23806.title: WorkWorlds: An Infrastructure for Evaluating AI Agents on Workplace Tasks
2609.23806.paper_summary: Many knowledge-work benchmarks are constructed around individual tasks, with the context needed for each task selected together with or after the task has been specified. This design measures performance on workplace-like tasks in an environment assembled for the task. When task specification guides which context is selected, the evaluation can encode task information into the environment and pre-complete part of the information-localization work that workplace performance normally requires. We introduce WorkWorlds, an evaluation infrastructure that separates organizational state from task specification. A world first fixes a revision, date, and employee seat and materializes the organizational state that employee can access; tasks are introduced only afterward. We implement WorkWorlds in a primary synthetic pharmaceutical company with 8 measured tasks across 6 employee seats, and construct additional organizational worlds. Across 192 matched evaluations, task-level curation increased evidence access by 17.6 percentage points, from 72.8% to 90.4%, and criterion pass by 8.7 points, from 68.0% to 76.7%, while pass conditional on evidence access remained nearly unchanged; most of the measured difference occurred before the agent reached sufficient evidence.
2609.23806.paper_summary_zh: 許多知識工作基準是圍繞個別任務構建的，所需的上下文是在任務指定之前或之後一起選擇的。這種設計在為任務組裝的環境中測量類似工作場所的任務表現。當任務規範指導所選擇的上下文時，評估可以將任務信息編碼到環境中，並預先完成工作場所表現通常所需的部分信息定位工作。我們介紹了WorkWorlds，一種將組織狀態與任務規範分開的評估基礎設施。一個世界首先固定了修訂、日期和員工座位，並具現化員工可以訪問的組織狀態；任務則是在此之後引入。我們在一家主要的合成製藥公司中實施了WorkWorlds，測量了6個員工座位上的8個任務，並構建了額外的組織世界。在192次匹配評估中，任務級策展使證據訪問增加了17.6個百分點，從72.8%提高到90.4%，標準通過率提高了8.7個點，從68.0%提高到76.7%，而基於證據訪問的通過率幾乎保持不變；大多數測量差異發生在代理達到足夠證據之前。
2609.23806.author: Yining Hua et.al.
